analysis: Independent subject-split reporting and omnibus sensitivities
testing_strength_selection: Existing production EB choices, not reselected for the modified-likelihood sensitivity
baseline_estimation: Current analytic EC optimizer, refitted independently within each subject half; common to reporting alternatives
reporting_selection: Existing comparator-matched event-BH union, with explicit selected and evaluable denominators
direction_definition: Positive inner product after aligning paths by genomic signature
dirichlet_pooling: Covariance-matched fractional effective-count approximation; failed fits fall back to the equal-subject estimate in the operational comparison
omnibus_reporting_control: Explicit concentration-1 subject-blocked regression arrays, independent of method ordering
null_assessment_limitation: Held permutations assess calibration-pool generalization; they do not establish biological-null calibration under heteroscedasticity

gaussian_simulation.null_definition: Zero cell-type ILR coefficients; this need not imply equal mean proportions

paired_combinations: All eligible archived marginal contrasts, no significance screen; Bonferroni, Simes, ACAT; joint subject dependence not certified by independently seeded marginal nulls
long_read_mapping: Complete tested omnibus block set, using fractional source counts and the existing fixed P56 cell-type mapping
long_read_contrast_selection: Largest short-read effect or smallest analytic-tail paired contrast among mapped cell types, before source depth or direction checks
long_read_comparison: Own all-tested, own BH-selected, and common-tested/source-evaluable universes reported separately; top 40, 100, 200
rank_metric: Mean cumulative directional agreement at integer ranks 1 through K, not ROC AUC
profiled_fitter: Absolute path ILRs plus optional independently fitted block mass, fixed within-class transcript mixtures; experimental only
